articles.summary: Emmanuel Caprais, former Senior Vice President and CFO of ITT, Inc., to become Henry Schein’s CFO effective November 4, 2026. Mr. Caprais will join the Company in an advisory capacity beginning October 12, 2026, to support a structured transition. CFO Ronald N. South to transition to Senior Advisor role on November 4, 2026. Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) announced today that Emmanuel Caprais, former Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of ITT, Inc. (NYSE: ITT), has been named the Company’s Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective November 4, 2026. Mr. Caprais will join the Henry Schein Leadership Team (HSLT) and report to Frederick M. Lowery, Chief Executive Officer of Henry Schein. To support a structured transition, Mr. Caprais will initially serve as Senior Financial Advisor beginning on October 12, 2026. After 18 years with the Company, Ronald N. articles.summary: Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC), the world’s largest provider of healthcare solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners, announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the stock market opens on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and will provide a live webcast of its earnings conference call on the same day beginning at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time. Speakers on the call will include Fred Lowery, Chief Executive Officer, Ronald N. South, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, and Emmanuel Caprais, Senior Financial Advisor. Investors can access the call by visiting https://investor.henryschein.com/webcasts . A replay will be available on the Henry Schein website following the presentation. About Henry Schein, Inc. articles.summary: MELVILLE, N.Y. - October 12, 2026 - Henry Schein Medical, the U.S. medical business of Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC), has been awarded national group purchasing agreements for its Bedside and Incontinence categories with Premier, Inc., effective June 1, 2026, and August 1, 2026, respectively. The new agreements allow Premier members, at their discretion, to take advantage of special pricing and terms pre-negotiated by Premier for Henry Scheins bedside and incontinence product portfolios. articles.title: Henry Schein Medical Awarded Bedside and Incontinence Category Agreements with Premier, Inc.
